summary: Completed backend + frontend + native/CI verification for Sports Hub V2 scope. Public sportshub endpoints and regression monkeypatch tests passed; Astra preview V2 screenshots and interaction checks passed at 1920x800 and 390x844. Native Android build is currently blocked by a Kotlin compile error in GameActivity plus offline dependency-cache limitation.
action_items: Fix native compile blocker in /app/android/onnowtv-livetv/app/src/main/java/tv/onnowtv/livetv/GameActivity.kt line ~123: ScrollView.apply scope resolves `right` to ScrollView.right (Int), causing `addView(right)` type mismatch.
After fixing compile error, re-run :app:compileDebugKotlin with the same command and then run JVM test target for SportsPresentationTest.
If offline mode is required in CI/preview compile checks, prewarm/cache kotlin-compiler-embeddable:1.9.22 or remove offline for compile validation stage.
critical_code_review_comments: Native compile cannot currently pass: with network enabled, :app:compileDebugKotlin fails at GameActivity.kt:123:178 (Type mismatch Int vs View).
Offline compile path additionally fails when kotlin-compiler-embeddable:1.9.22 is not already cached; this is environmental but blocks strict offline verification.

Kotlin client cancellation handling likely swallows cancellation as null data: SportsHubApi.getJson onFailure always resumes null (no distinction for call cancellation), which can mask cancellation state in app flow.
Real IPTV/channel playback and signed-in device handoff remain unverified in this environment (hardware/account dependent).

rca of the issue: Native compile blocker RCA: In GameActivity.kt, property name `right` (LinearLayout) is shadowed inside `ScrollView(ctx).apply { ... }` by receiver property `ScrollView.right` (Int). `addView(right)` resolves to Int argument, producing the Kotlin compile error `Type mismatch: inferred type is Int but View! was expected` at line 123. Mitigation: disambiguate as `addView(this@GameActivity.right)` or rename the class property. Secondary blocker: strict offline compile fails when kotlin compiler artifact is not cached.
